newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur sees strong rise in 1997 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur sees strong rise in 1997 EPS.

text.p: Winterthur Group said it was on track to achieve double-digit profit growth in 1997 and earnings per share (EPS) should also rise significantly.

"On the basis of the excellent starting positions, the positive effects of the restructuring measures, the quality of insurance portfolio, and the favourable financial result we expect, we are likely to achieve another double-digit increase in our 1997 profit as against 1996," chairman Peter Spaelti said in the text of a speech.
He also said EPS should rise significantly, despite a larger number of dividend-bearing shares.
